title: Upper DE + Rotation
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Lateral Lunge × 6/side · Eccentric Push-Up with Extension × 5 · Bird Dog × 6/side
jumps: Side to side over a line
strength: Dynamic effort: moderate DBs moved as FAST as possible · rest 1:00
note: Strength block starts. Slow 6-second lowering on the main lift, then explode. Expect soreness: accessories are cut back.
